defaultPrompt: Audit this repo's AI process rules.

interface.longDescription: Packages the Tautline AI Delivery Methodology as a Codex skill bundle for adapter-backed software delivery. It helps teams start lanes, pin framework versions, plan and advance goals, coordinate reviews, triage bugs through adapter policy, run migration and public-release checks, capture continuity, publish RCA or feature-request artifacts, and keep long-running AI work visible. Detailed procedures live in the skill files, policy modules, and docs/reference/plugin-capability-catalog.md.
interface.shortDescription: Canonical AI delivery process, reviews, gates, and adapters.
